paragraphs: Rav Shimi bar Ashi. Rav Pappa used to say of him, ‘May the Merciful One save us from Shimi's embarrassments.’ He heard and accepted silence. Heilprin rejects the locators Ha-Kore Et Ha-Megillah Omed and Mo'ed Katan and gives Ta'anit 9, beginning of b. He associates the Mo'ed Katan locator with Tosafot on Niddah 24a [the checked Rashi there gives that locator]. (see Rav Pappa). In one telling, he swallowed a snake and was healed through Elijah: Shemonah Sheratzim, Shabbat 109b. Heilprin reports that he healed a gentile’s skin affliction: Mi She-Ahazo, Gittin 70a. The Semag, negative commandment 45, reports that Rambam relied on this passage in treating Muslims in Egypt. If he was the earlier Ashi's son, whose brother R' Hiyya was Rav's pupil, then he lived long. He found Abaye explaining to his son: Yoma 27, beginning of a; Kiddushin 48b. He wished to learn from Abaye and irrigated his fields; Abaye did not eat the fruit of that year: Gittin 60b. Rav Kahana transmitted in his name: Hullin 53a; Rav Kahana stated a teaching before Rav Shimi: Temurah 28a. Hullin 11b has simply ‘before Rav Shimi.’ Rav Kahana escorted Rav Shimi to the palm trees of Babylonia; The next case describes Rav Mordekhai escorting Rav Ashi. Heilprin flags the comparison for examination. Rav Pappa bar Rav Hanan of Bei Kelohit stated a teaching before him [Ketubbot 40b]. He challenged Rav Pappa: Eruvin 3b. In Rava's name: end of Hotzi'u Lo. Also R' Shmuel מתווך [provisionally ‘of Tavvakh’]. Ketubbot 60, beginning of a: Rav Shimi bar Abaye said that the halakhah follows R' Yitzhak, who spoke in R' Yohanan's name; Rif and Asheri have bar Ashi, and the new Talmud editions did not correct it. Zevahim 71b: Rav Ashi said, ‘I stated the teaching before Rav Shimi.’ I do not know which Shimi this is.
